title: Mixed Duo #42
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Japanese, in her mid 30s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, long black hair in twin tails tied with pink and black ribbons under a blunt fringe, a hollow, dreamy expression, wavy hair, real pores, real living eyes, 15 segment rings piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a bracelet. Painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework, a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold-and-red bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing with both arms raised overhead, elbows bent, torso fully visible, extreme gold-and-red extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her early 30s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, long pastel rainbow hair in twin tails crowded with colourful plastic clips, ribbons and tiny toys kept on the hair, a bright, giddy grin, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 studs piercings set with diamonds in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of silver an anklet. Painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic, a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, extreme gold extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
